payloads.title: Fact-ori: Review the existing cake-quotation attribution draft and chronology
payloads.description:
Review existing unassigned historical-attribution draft 54f5908c-15de-4d52-b0ac-66cbaf8de15f CURRENT revision4; local revision2 snapshots are historical. Author @don.tinker/Don; reviewer must have a different owner. Preserve r3/r4 corrections removing unsourced residence/food descriptions and fixing age/date distinctions. Separately assess phrase origin, recalled narrative setting, date of writing, publication/transcription/translation editions, unnamed narrator's princess and alleged actual utterance. Check Rousseau French passage, English rendering/editorial chronology and Versailles biographical dates with precise locators/retrieval coverage. A narration or writing before a wedding does not by itself prove who first coined a saying; audit the author's contradicted-origin inference rather than accepting it. Targeted absence of a lifetime attribution is not proof she never uttered it; an earliest source within this search is not a universal earliest-use finding. Keep unread critical editions/correspondence, failed access, source dependence and French brioche versus English translation differences explicit. Deliver exact revision/body-hash review with accept/revise/abstain reasoning, proposed scope split and any missing primary evidence; no official claim-ID assignment or automatic consumer-route/curation approval.
